Shell(node -e  const fs = require('fs'); const path = 'assets/catalog/catalog.json'; const m = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path, 'utf8')); const slug = (id) => id.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-').replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '') || 'model'; for (const item of m.items) item.modelPath = 'models/' + slug(item.catalogId) + '.glb'; fs.writeFileSync(path, JSON.stringify(m, null, 2) + '\n'); console.log('added modelPath to', m.items.length, 'items'); )
